required_invariants: Official Mountain Creativity School logo remains the application brand asset
Family and teacher accounts are created only by administration
No public family self-registration is available in the production shell
Administrator can create family or teacher access with a temporary password
Temporary passwords must be replaced on first successful login
Administrator can reset a temporary password without seeing the user's personal password
Administrator can revoke access without deleting historical academic records
Family and teacher users can change their own password from the account controls
Admin communication supports whole community, cycle, grade, one student and selected students
Teacher communication supports grade, one student and selected students only inside assigned classrooms
All dashboard communication entry points route through the same Mounty audience flow
Mounty never sends AI output without human review
Mounty UI never exposes the raw Supabase non-2xx error string
Mounty retries transient upstream AI failures
Mounty errors include a request reference when available
Teachers are scoped by mf_classroom_staff
Families only access linked students
Legacy auth is not loaded by the production shell
Service worker does not cache Supabase function requests
Six early-childhood levels remain available
Transportation remains a separate application
Privacy policy is reachable before sign-in and inside the app
Family users can initiate account deletion inside the app
An external account deletion request resource is publicly reachable
Production exposes an explicit offline state and keyboard focus visibility
New and recovered passwords require at least 8 characters while existing login compatibility is preserved
Native App Store or Play Store readiness is not claimed until native packaging exists
